capabilities: Highlight and underline selected text in Reading View and Live Preview
Annotate text in Obsidian's PDF reader and group excerpts by page
List a note's excerpts in a sidebar under their nearest heading
Filter highlights by pen style and color
Copy or create a Markdown note from selected excerpts
disambiguation: Not a code syntax highlighter; it marks selected text with colored pens and underlines.
extras: Highlights and preferences are stored in the plugin's data.json, not in the notes, so they only appear while the plugin is enabled; scanned PDFs need a selectable text layer and OCR is not included; physical iOS/Android testing is still pending; optional companion theme Animal Island Cozy and plugin Animal Island Calendar are named but not required.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to mark passages with colored highlights and collect them later without editing the note's own Markdown.
summary: Annotates selected text in notes and PDFs with colored highlighters and underlines, then lists, filters and exports the excerpts.
